newsitem.title: UK: HONG KONG STOCKS IN LONDON RISE IN THIN TRADE.
newsitem.headline: HONG KONG STOCKS IN LONDON RISE IN THIN TRADE.

text.p: Hong Kong shares were higher in quiet trade in London on Tuesday, with HSBC Holdings standing out as the only mover of the day, traders said.
"It has been very quiet, with HSBC moving up and down a (Hong Kong) dollar or two," one trader said.
The Hang Seng London reference index gained 25.79 points, a movement of 0.16 percent, to 16,409.20 points.
The Hang Seng in Hong Kong closed down 77.06 points, or 0.47 percent, at 16,383.41.
HSBC hit a high of HK$275 in London, from the open of HK$274.25, only to drift back to HK$274.50 later on.
-- Nicholas Winning, London newsroom +44 171 542 4367 ($ = 7.743 Hong Kong Dollars)
